collection.name: homenshum-cheiron/agent-skills
collection.note: This map describes that pin. The map file itself is a later documentation commit and adds no runtime.

stages.name: Workflow documentation
stages.human_intervention_remains: People still choose, adapt, and load a skill.
stages.missing_proof: Publication does not certify that a host follows the text.
stages.evidence_note: README catalog and skill folders at the pinned commit.

stages.name: Deterministic contracts
stages.human_intervention_remains: A person still decides whether a passing check is about the right claim.
stages.missing_proof: Local checkers do not prove a product gain or grant permission.
stages.evidence_note: Offline validators and unit tests described in docs/verification.md.

stages.name: Task autonomy within stated permissions
stages.human_intervention_remains: Unknown. Missing intervention logs are not zero.
stages.missing_proof: No published census of attempts, failures, timeouts, abstentions, or rescues.
stages.evidence_note: The runtime sketch in the method notes is an unvalidated hypothesis.

stages.name: Repeated improvement
stages.human_intervention_remains: A test, adopt, or rollback would still need an existing authorization gate.
stages.missing_proof: No published frozen-target lineage with held-out confirmation.
stages.evidence_note: The method is written. An end-to-end promotion lineage is not.

stages.name: Meta-improvement
stages.human_intervention_remains: A change to the improvement process would need its own authorization and evaluation.
stages.missing_proof: No shown mechanism plus an effect on a later improvement.
stages.evidence_note: A prompt edit alone would not establish this claim.
